records.title: STK11/LKB1-Deficient Phenotype Rather Than Mutation Diminishes Immunotherapy Efficacy and Represents STING/Type I Interferon/CD8+ T-Cell Dysfunction in NSCLC.
records.primary_classification: STK11功能表型与免疫治疗分层
records.boundary: Exploratory trial biomarker subsets, not a prospectively validated treatment-selection assay. Only OAK has tissue STK11 data; RAS84 is a transcriptomic surrogate, not measured KRAS genotype. Treatment interactions differ by trial/endpoint (OAK OS P=.27; ORIENT-11 OS/PFS P=.15). Def-group CD8 OS trends are nonsignificant; bulk inference does not prove T-cell dysfunction or STING causality. Figure1 says eight common genes but lists seven; cohort-specific feature availability and quartile thresholds limit deployment. Separate supplements not supplied. OAK tissue genomic labels are available, but their sequencing-platform resolution is not verified from the supplied main text; no targeted-DNA assay tag is assigned.
